passages.text: A learned person shall examine a man's (1) Kshetra (body), (2) Mrija (complexion), (3) Swara (voice), (4) Sara (strength), (5) Samhati (joints), (6) Sneha (gloss), (7) Varna (color), (8) Anuka (shape of the face), (9) Unmana (height), (10) Mana (weight), (11) Prakriti (disposition) and (12) Gati (gait) and then predict his fortune.
passages.summary: The text says a learned person should examine twelve features of a man (body, complexion, voice, strength, joints, gloss, color, shape of the face, height, weight, disposition and gait) before predicting his fortune.

passages.text: If the feet be dry, with soft soles, of the color of the lotus, with close toes, beautiful, red nails, beautiful heels, always warm without visible sinews, with invisible ankle and raised like the turtle, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the feet are dry, soft-soled, lotus-colored, close-toed and handsome, with red nails, fine heels, warmth, no visible sinews, hidden ankles and an arch like a turtle's back, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the feet be like winnows, crooked or bent, covered with sinews, dry, with toes not close and with nail white and not glossy, the person will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the feet are shaped like winnowing baskets, crooked, sinewy and dry, with spread toes and pale dull nails, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the feet be large, he will walk much ;
passages.summary: The text says that a person with large feet will walk a great deal.

passages.text: [the feet] if of brown color, his family will perish ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the feet are brown, the person's family will perish.

passages.text: if the soles be of the color of burnt clay, he will murder a Brahmin ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the soles are the color of burnt clay, the person will murder a Brahmin.

passages.text: [the feet] and if the color be yellow, he will have sexual intercourse with women under prohibition.
passages.summary: The text says that if the feet are yellow, the person will have relations with women forbidden to him.

passages.text: If the shanks be covered with hair, thin and scattered, and if they be round, if the thighs be like the trunk of the elephant, and if the knees be large and both alike, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the shins have thin, scattered hair and are round, the thighs are like an elephant's trunk, and the knees are large and matched, the person will be a king.

passages.text: But if the shanks resemble those of a dog or a jackal, the person will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the shins resemble those of a dog or jackal, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If a single hair grow from each cell over the body, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if a single hair grows from each pore of the body, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [each cell over the body] if two hairs grow from it, the person will be learned and will scrupulously observe the duties of life as prescribed in the Vedas ;
passages.summary: The text says that if two hairs grow from each pore, the person will be learned and will carefully follow the duties laid down in the Vedas.

passages.text: [each cell over the body] if three or more, the person will be poor and afflicted with grief.
passages.summary: The text says that if three or more hairs grow from each pore, the person will be poor and troubled by grief.

passages.text: The same remarks apply to the hairs of the head.
passages.summary: The text says the same rules apply to the hairs of the head.

passages.text: If there be no flesh in the knees, the person will die in his travels ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the knees have no flesh, the person will die while travelling.

passages.text: if the knees be small, he will become popular;
passages.summary: The text says that a person with small knees will become popular.

passages.text: [the knees] if broad, he will become poor;
passages.summary: The text says that a person with broad knees will become poor.

passages.text: [the knees] if sunk, he will be subject to women ;
passages.summary: The text says that a person with sunken knees will be ruled by women.

passages.text: [the knees] if covered with flesh, he will become a king,
passages.summary: The text says that a person with fleshy knees will become a king.

passages.text: [the knees] and if large, he will live long.
passages.summary: The text says that a person with large knees will live long.

passages.text: If the penis be small, the person will be rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is small, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the penis] if large he will have no sons ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is large, the person will have no sons.

passages.text: [the penis] if it be inclined on the left side, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis leans to the left, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the penis] if not straight, he will be without sons and without money ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is not straight, the person will have neither sons nor money.

passages.text: [the penis] if straight, he will have sons;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is straight, the person will have sons.

passages.text: [the penis] if pointing to the ground, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis points downward, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the penis] if covered with muscles, he will have very few sons ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is covered with muscles, the person will have very few sons.

passages.text: if the nut of the penis be large, he will live in comfort,
passages.summary: The text says that if the head of the penis is large, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: and if the penis be soft, he will die of urinary and the like diseases.
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is soft, the person will die of urinary or similar diseases.

passages.text: If the nut be invisible, he will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head of the penis is hidden, the person will be a king.

passages.text: if the penis be long and fallen, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is long and hanging, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the penis] and if either straight and round or small and with sinews, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the penis is straight and round, or small and sinewy, the person will be rich.

passages.text: A person with a single testicle will suffer death by drowning;
passages.summary: The text says a person with a single testicle will die by drowning.

passages.text: if the testicles be not alike, he will be fond of sexual intercourse ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the testicles are unequal, the person will be fond of sex.

passages.text: [the testicles] if both be alike, he will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if both testicles are equal, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the testicles] if they be raised up, the person will not live long ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the testicles are drawn up, the person will not live long.

passages.text: [the testicles] and if they hang down he will live to the age of 100 years.
passages.summary: The text says that if the testicles hang low, the person will live to 100 years.

passages.text: If the nut of the penis be red, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head of the penis is red, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the nut of the penis] if it be either white or of dim color, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head of the penis is white or dull in color, the person will be poor.

passages.text: if the urine fall with noise, the person will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if urination is noisy, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the urine] and if without noise, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if urination is silent, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the urine fall in two, three or four lines and twisting from left to right, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the urine falls in two to four streams twisting from left to right, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the urine] and if it fall broken and scattered, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the urine falls broken and scattered, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the urine fall in a line and twisted, the person will get a very beautiful son.
passages.summary: The text says that if the urine falls in a single twisted stream, the person will have a very beautiful son.

passages.text: If the glans penis be glossy, raised and even, the person will enjoy wealthy women gems.
passages.summary: The text says that if the glans is glossy, raised and even, the person will enjoy wealth, women and gems.

passages.text: If the glans penis be depressed in the middle, the person will get daughters and will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the glans is dipped in the middle, the person will have daughters and be poor.

passages.text: [the glans penis] if raised in the middle, he will possess many cows;
passages.summary: The text says that if the glans is raised in the middle, the person will own many cows.

passages.text: [the glans penis] if it be not very large or very much raised, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the glans is neither very large nor very raised, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the urinary orifice be dry, the person will be poor and ugly ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the urinary opening is dry, the person will be poor and ugly.

passages.text: if the semen smell like a flower, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells like a flower, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the semen should smell like honey, the person will be very rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells like honey, the person will be very rich.

passages.text: [the semen] if it smell like fish, he will have many children ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells like fish, the person will have many children.

passages.text: [the semen] if it be thin, he will get daughters,
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen is thin, the person will have daughters.

passages.text: [the semen] and if of the smell of flesh, he will live in great comfort.
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells like flesh, the person will live in great comfort.

passages.text: If it be of the smell of alcohol, the person will perform sacrificial fire ceremonies;
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells of alcohol, the person will perform sacrificial fire rites.

passages.text: [it] if of the smell of salt, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the semen smells of salt, the person will be poor.

passages.text: A person whose sexual intercourse lasts for a short time, will live long ;
passages.summary: The text says a person whose intercourse is brief will live long.

passages.text: [A person whose sexual intercourse lasts for a short time,] if otherwise, he will die early.
passages.summary: The text says a person whose intercourse is not brief will die early.

passages.text: A person whose rump is large, will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says a person with a large rump will be poor.

passages.text: If the rump be full of flesh, the person will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the rump is fleshy, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the rump] if it be half the average size, he will be sickly ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the rump is half the normal size, the person will be sickly.

passages.text: [the rump] and if it resemble that of a frog, he will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the rump resembles a frog's, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the loins resemble those of the lion, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the loins resemble a lion's, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the loins] if they resemble those of the monkey or the camel, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the loins resemble a monkey's or camel's, the person will be poor.

passages.text: if the abdomen be even, the person will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the abdomen is even, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the abdomen] if it be like a pot, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the abdomen is pot-shaped, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the sides be not defective, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the sides of the body are without defect, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the sides] if they be depressed and bent, he will have no enjoyment;
passages.summary: The text says that if the sides are sunken and bent, the person will have no enjoyment.

passages.text: if the belly be even, the person will live well;
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly is even, the person will live well.

passages.text: [the belly] if it be depressed, he will have no enjoyment.
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly is sunken, the person will have no enjoyment.

passages.text: If the belly be high, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly is high, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the belly] if it be uneven, he will be a man of perverted understanding;
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly is uneven, the person will have a twisted understanding.

passages.text: [the belly] if it be like that of the serpent, he will be poor and gluttonous.
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly is like a serpent's, the person will be poor and gluttonous.

passages.text: If the navel be broad and high all round, the person will live in comfort ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel is broad and raised all round, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the navel] if it be small and if the pit be not visible, the person will be afflicted with miseries.
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel is small with no visible hollow, the person will suffer miseries.

passages.text: If the navel be in the middle of a fold of the skin or if it be depressed, the person will suffer from belly-ache and will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel sits in a fold of skin or is sunken, the person will suffer from belly-ache and be poor.

passages.text: if the navel turn from right to left, the person will be a cheat ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel turns from right to left, the person will be a cheat.

passages.text: [the navel] if it turn from left to right, he will be a man of good perception and strong memory.
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel turns from left to right, the person will have good perception and a strong memory.

passages.text: If the navel extend on both sides horizontally, the person will live long ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel extends sideways in both directions, the person will live long.

passages.text: [the navel] if it extend vertically upwards, he will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel extends upward, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the navel] if vertically downwards, he will have cows ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel extends downward, the person will own cows.

passages.text: [the navel] and if it be like the color of the lotus, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the navel is lotus-colored, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If there be one, two, three or four folds of skin in the belly, the person will die wounded by a weapon, will enjoy women, will become a teacher and will be vastly learned respectively.
passages.summary: The text says that one, two, three or four skin folds on the belly mean, in turn, death by a weapon, enjoyment of women, becoming a teacher, and great learning.

passages.text: If there be no folds, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if there are no folds on the belly, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the folds be not straight, the person will be wicked and will have sexual intercourse with women under prohibition ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly folds are not straight, the person will be wicked and will have relations with forbidden women.

passages.text: [the folds] if they be straight, he will live in comfort and will never covet the wives of other men.
passages.summary: The text says that if the belly folds are straight, the person will live in comfort and never desire other men's wives.

passages.text: If the sides be fleshy and soft and if the ringlets of hair over them turn from left to right, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the sides are fleshy and soft with hair curling from left to right, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [If the sides be fleshy and soft and if the ringlets of hair over them turn from left to right,] If otherwise, he will be poor and wretched and will serve under others.
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be poor and wretched and will work under others.

passages.text: If the nipple of the breast be not high, the person will be popular;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nipples are not raised, the person will be popular.

passages.text: if the two nipples be long and not alike, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nipples are long and unequal, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the two nipples] if they be large, whether high or sunk, the person will be a king and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The text says that if the nipples are large, raised or sunken, the person will be a king and live in comfort.

passages.text: If the bosom be high, broad, fleshy and firm, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is high, broad, fleshy and firm, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [If the bosom be high, broad, fleshy and firm,] if otherwise and covered with stiff hair and muscles, the person will be the meanest of mankind.
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is otherwise and covered with stiff hair and muscles, the person will be the lowest of mankind.

passages.text: If the bosom be even, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is even, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the bosom] if large, he will be a hero ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is large, the person will be a hero.

passages.text: [the bosom] if small, poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is small, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the bosom] if uneven, he will be poor and die by a weapon.
passages.summary: The text says that if the chest is uneven, the person will be poor and die by a weapon.

passages.text: If the collar bones be not alike, the person will be wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the collar bones are unequal, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: if the joints of the bones be large, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the joints of the collar bones are large, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the joints of the bones] if they be high, he will live well ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the joints are raised, the person will live well.

passages.text: [the joints of the bones] if depressed, he will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the joints are sunken, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the joints of the bones] and if large, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the joints are large, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the neck be flat or dry or covered with muscles, the person will become poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the neck is flat, dry or muscular, the person will become poor.

passages.text: [the neck] if it be like that of the buffalo, he will be a valiant soldier ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the neck is like a buffalo's, the person will be a brave soldier.

passages.text: [the neck] and if it be like that of the ox, he will die by a weapon.
passages.summary: The text says that if the neck is like an ox's, the person will die by a weapon.

passages.text: If the neck be like the conch shell, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the neck is like a conch shell, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the neck] if it be hanging, the person will be a glutton ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the neck sags, the person will be a glutton.

passages.text: if the back be even and without hairs, the person will be rich,
passages.summary: The text says that if the back is even and hairless, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [if the back be even and without hairs,] otherwise, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the armpits be dry, large, high, of good smell, both alike and with much hair, the person will be rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the armpits are dry, large, high, pleasant-smelling, matched and hairy, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [If the armpits be dry, large, high, of good smell, both alike and with much hair,] if otherwise, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the shoulders be without flesh, covered with hair, sunk and small, the person will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the shoulders are fleshless, hairy, sunken and small, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the shoulders] but if broad, high and close, he will live in comfort and be powerful.
passages.summary: The text says that if the shoulders are broad, high and compact, the person will live in comfort and be powerful.

passages.text: If the two arms be round, like the trunk of the elephant, large, both alike, and hanging down to the knees, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the arms are round like an elephant's trunk, large, matched and reach the knees, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the two arms] but if they be short and covered with hair, he will be the meanest of mankind.
passages.summary: The text says that if the arms are short and hairy, the person will be the lowest of mankind.

passages.text: If the fingers of the hand be long, the person will live in comfort ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers are long, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the fingers of the hand] if they be without skinfolds, he will be popular;
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers have no skin folds, the person will be popular.

passages.text: [the fingers of the hand] if small, he will be intelligent ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers are small, the person will be intelligent.

passages.text: [the fingers of the hand] and if flat, he will serve under others.
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers are flat, the person will work under others.

passages.text: If the fingers of the hand be large, the person will be poor,
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers are large, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the fingers of the hand] and if bent upwards, he will die by weapons.
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers bend upward, the person will die by weapons.

passages.text: If the hands be like those of the monkey, the person will be rich,
passages.summary: The text says that if the hands are like a monkey's, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the hands] and if like those of the tiger, he will be wicked.
passages.summary: The text says that if the hands are like a tiger's, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: If the wrists be invisible, firm and close, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the wrists are hidden, firm and compact, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [If the wrists be invisible, firm and close,] if otherwise and if the joints be loose, the hands will suffer sword-cut ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the wrists are otherwise and the joints loose, the hands will be cut by a sword.

passages.text: [the wrists] and if they should crack, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the wrists crack, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the palm of the hand be hollow, the person will not inherit his father's property ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm is hollow, the person will not inherit his father's property.

passages.text: [the palm of the hand] if it be round and hollow, he will be rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm is round and hollow, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the palm of the hand] and if high, he will be generous.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm is raised, the person will be generous.

passages.text: If the palms of both hands be alike, the person will be poor and wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if both palms are alike, the person will be poor and wicked.

passages.text: [the palms] if red, he will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palms are red, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the palms] if yellow, he will cohabit with women under prohibition ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palms are yellow, the person will have relations with forbidden women.

passages.text: [the palms] and if dry, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palms are dry, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the nail resemble the husk of paddy, the person will be a hermaphrodite ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nails resemble rice husks, the person will be a hermaphrodite.

passages.text: [the nail] if flat and split, he will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nails are flat and split, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the nail] if of bad color, he will be of wrong views ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nails are badly colored, the person will hold wrong views.

passages.text: [the nail] and if red, he will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the nails are red, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If, in the middle of the thumb, there be lines of the shape of a barley, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if there are barley-grain-shaped lines in the middle of the thumb, the person will be rich.

passages.text: if the same be found at the root of the thumb, he will have sons.
passages.summary: The text says that if such barley-shaped lines are at the base of the thumb, the person will have sons.

passages.text: If the joints of the fingers be long, the person will be popular and will live long.
passages.summary: The text says that if the finger joints are long, the person will be popular and live long.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm of the hand be glossy and deep, the man will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines are glossy and deep, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [If the lines in the palm of the hand be glossy and deep,] if otherwise, he will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be poor.

passages.text: if the fingers be not close, the person will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers have gaps between them, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the fingers] and if close, he will earn much money.
passages.summary: The text says that if the fingers are close together, the person will earn much money.

passages.text: If the three lines issuing from the wrist reach the middle of the palm, the person will be a king,
passages.summary: The text says that if three lines from the wrist reach the middle of the palm, the person will be a king.

passages.text: and if there be two marks of the shape of the fish in the middle of the palm, the person will daily feed many people.
passages.summary: The text says that if two fish-shaped marks are in the middle of the palm, the person will feed many people every day.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm be of the shape of vajrayudha, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form the shape of a thunderbolt weapon (vajrayudha), the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the lines in the palm] if they be of the shape of the tail of the fish, he will be learned ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a fish's tail, the person will be learned.

passages.text: [the lines in the palm] if of the shape of a conch shell, an umbrella, a palankin, an elephant, a horse or a lotus, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a conch, umbrella, palanquin, elephant, horse or lotus, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm of the hand be of the shape of a pot, the stem of a lotus, a flag or the hook of the elephant driver, the person will be a guardian of treasure.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a pot, lotus stem, flag or elephant-driver's hook, the person will be a keeper of treasure.

passages.text: If the lines appear twisted like a rope, or if the lines be triangular in shape, the person will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines are twisted like a rope or form a triangle, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm of the hand be of the shape of the discus, the sword, the axe, the club, the spear or the bow, the person will be a commander of armies ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a discus, sword, axe, club, spear or bow, the person will command armies.

passages.text: if the lines be of the shape of a mortar, the person will perform sacrificial fire ceremonies.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a mortar, the person will perform sacrificial fire rites.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm of the hand be of the shape of a crocodile, a flag, or a cow-shed, the person will be very rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a crocodile, flag or cow-shed, the person will be very rich.

passages.text: if the lines at the root of the thumb be of the shape of a Vedi (sacrificial altar), the person will perform sacrificial rites.
passages.summary: The text says that if the lines at the base of the thumb form a sacrificial altar, the person will perform sacrificial rites.

passages.text: If the lines in the palm of the hand be of the shape of a tank, a temple and the like, or if they be triangular in shape, the person will do acts of charity.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm lines form a water tank, a temple or the like, or a triangle, the person will do acts of charity.

passages.text: The big lines below the thumb indicate sons and the small lines daughters.
passages.summary: The text says that large lines below the thumb indicate sons and small lines indicate daughters.

passages.text: Lines reaching the root of the forefinger indicate the age of the person to be 100; if the line be of shorter length, the age shall be ascertained by proportion.
passages.summary: The text says that lines reaching the base of the forefinger indicate a lifespan of 100 years, and shorter lines a proportionally shorter one.

passages.text: If the lines be broken, the person will fall from a tree ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the lines are broken, the person will fall from a tree.

passages.text: if there be either many lines or no lines, the person will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the palm has very many lines or none, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the chin be very small and long, the person will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chin is very small and long, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the chin] if covered with flesh, he will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the chin is fleshy, the person will be rich.

passages.text: if the lower lip be red and straight, the person will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the lower lip is red and straight, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the lower lip] and if small he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the lower lip is small, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the lips be split or appear cut or of bad color or dry, the person will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the lips are split, look cut, are badly colored or dry, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the teeth be glossy, close, sharp and regular, the person will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the teeth are glossy, close, sharp and even, the person will be happy.

passages.text: If the tongue be red, long, smooth and even, the person will live in comfort ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the tongue is red, long, smooth and even, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the tongue] but if it be white or black and dry, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the tongue is white or black and dry, the person will be poor.

passages.text: the same remarks apply to the corners of the mouth.
passages.summary: The text says the same rules apply to the corners of the mouth.

passages.text: If the face be beautiful, slightly open-mouthed, clear, smooth and even, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is beautiful, slightly open-mouthed, clear, smooth and even, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [If the face be beautiful, slightly open-mouthed, clear, smooth and even,] and if otherwise, he will be afflicted with grief ;
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be troubled by grief.

passages.text: if the face be large, the person will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is large, the person will be happy.

passages.text: If the face be like that of a woman, the person will have no sons ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a man's face is like a woman's, he will have no sons.

passages.text: [the face] if it be round, he will be a cheat ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is round, the person will be a cheat.

passages.text: [the face] if long, poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is long, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the face] and if timid, wicked.
passages.summary: The text says that if the face looks timid, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: If the face be oblongular in shape, the person will be a cheat;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is oblong, the person will be a cheat.

passages.text: [the face] if depressed or sunk, he will have no sons ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is sunken, the person will have no sons.

passages.text: [the face] if very small, a miser ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is very small, the person will be a miser.

passages.text: [the face] and if full and beautiful, happy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is full and beautiful, the person will be happy.

passages.text: If the hair about the face be not split at the ends be soft, and bent, the person will be happy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the facial hair has no split ends and is soft and curved, the person will be happy.

passages.text: [the hair about the face] and if it be red, not glossy and small in quantity, the person will be a thief.
passages.summary: The text says that if the facial hair is red, dull and sparse, the person will be a thief.

passages.text: If the ears be without flesh, the person will die an unnatural death ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are fleshless, the person will die an unnatural death.

passages.text: [the ears] if like a cup, he will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are cup-shaped, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the ears] if small, he will be a miser ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are small, the person will be a miser.

passages.text: [the ears] and if they taper in a point like a cone, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears taper to a point like a cone, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the ears be covered with hair, the person will live long ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are hairy, the person will live long.

passages.text: [the ears] if they be broad, he will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are broad, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the ears] if covered with muscles, he will be wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears are covered with muscles, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: [the ears] and if they hang and be fleshy, he will live well.
passages.summary: The text says that if the ears hang down and are fleshy, the person will live well.

passages.text: If the cheek be not sunk, the person will live in comfort ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the cheeks are not sunken, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the cheek] if it be fleshy, he will become a minister.
passages.summary: The text says that if the cheeks are fleshy, the person will become a minister.

passages.text: If the nose be like that of the parrot, the person will live in comfort ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is like a parrot's beak, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the nose] and if it be dry, he will live long.
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is dry, the person will live long.

passages.text: If the nose appear as if cut, the person will cohabit with women under prohibition;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose looks as if cut, the person will have relations with forbidden women.

passages.text: [the nose] if it be long, he will be wealthy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is long, the person will be wealthy.

passages.text: [the nose] if bent, he will be a thief;
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is bent, the person will be a thief.

passages.text: [the nose] and if flat, he will be killed by a woman.
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is flat, the person will be killed by a woman.

passages.text: If the end of the nose be bent, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the tip of the nose is bent, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the end of the nose] if it be bent on the right side, he will be wicked and gluttonous ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the tip of the nose bends to the right, the person will be wicked and gluttonous.

passages.text: [the end of the nose] and if it be straight, with small holes and appear beautiful, the person will be wealthy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the nose is straight, with small nostrils and a handsome look, the person will be wealthy.

passages.text: If the sneeze occur twice or thrice at a time and the sound be not disagreeable, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a person sneezes two or three times at once with a pleasant sound, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the sneeze] and if it be long and of the same sound throughout, he will live long.
passages.summary: The text says that if the sneeze is long and even in sound, the person will live long.

passages.text: If the eyes be like the petals of the lotus, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are like lotus petals, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the eyes] and if the corners be red, he will be wealthy and prosperous ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the corners of the eyes are red, the person will be wealthy and prosperous.

passages.text: [the eyes] if of the color of honey, he will be exceedingly rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are honey-colored, the person will be exceedingly rich.

passages.text: [the eyes] and if they resemble the eyes of the cat, the person will be wicked.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes resemble a cat's, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: If the eyes be like those of the deer or round or squint, the person will be a thief ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are deer-like, round or squinting, the person will be a thief.

passages.text: [the eyes] if they see obliquely, he will be wicked;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes look sideways, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: [the eyes] and if they be like the eyes of the elephant, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are like an elephant's, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the eyes indicate courage, the person will be rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes show courage, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the eyes] if they be of the color of the blue lotus, he will be learned;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are the color of the blue lotus, the person will be learned.

passages.text: and if the eyes be exceedingly black, the person will become blind.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are extremely black, the person will become blind.

passages.text: If the eyes be large, the person will be a minister ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are large, the person will be a minister.

passages.text: [the eyes] if red-black, he will be wealthy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are reddish-black, the person will be wealthy.

passages.text: [the eyes] if they appear to be meek and imploring, the person will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes look meek and pleading, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the eyes] and if glossy, he will be very rich and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyes are glossy, the person will be very rich and live in comfort.

passages.text: If the brows be high and not broad, the person will die early ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows are high and narrow, the person will die early.

passages.text: [the brows] if high and broad, he will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows are high and broad, the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: if both brows be not alike, the person will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows are unequal, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the brows] and if they be bent like the young moon, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows curve like a crescent moon, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the brows be long and do not meet, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows are long and do not meet, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the brows] if they appear broken, he will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows look broken, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the brows] and if they be bent in the middle, he will cohabit with women under prohibition.
passages.summary: The text says that if the eyebrows bend in the middle, the person will have relations with forbidden women.

passages.text: If the temples be high and broad, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the temples are high and broad, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the temples] and if sunk, he will have neither sons nor money.
passages.summary: The text says that if the temples are sunken, the person will have neither sons nor money.

passages.text: If the fore-head be not even, the person will be poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is uneven, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the fore-head] and if it be like the half moon, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is shaped like a half moon, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the fore-head be like the pearl oyster and broad, the person will be a preceptor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is broad and shaped like a pearl oyster, the person will be a teacher.

passages.text: [the fore-head] if covered with muscles, he will be wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is covered with muscles, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: [the fore-head] and if the muscles be high and triangular in shape, he will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead muscles are raised and triangular, the person will be rich.

passages.text: If the fore-head be low, the person will be assassinated or put in prison and will be addicted to cruel deeds ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is low, the person will be assassinated or imprisoned and given to cruel deeds.

passages.text: [the fore-head] if it be high, he will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is high, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the fore-head] and if narrow, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead is narrow, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the weeping be without tears, agreeable to the ear and not of an imploring nature, the person will be happy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a person weeps without tears, pleasantly to the ear and without pleading, the person will be happy.

passages.text: [If the weeping be without tears, agreeable to the ear and not of an imploring nature,] if otherwise, he will be miserable.
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be miserable.

passages.text: If the laughter be unattended by the motion of the body, the person will be happy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a person laughs without moving the body, the person will be happy.

passages.text: [the laughter] if it be attended by the closing of the eyes, he will be wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a person closes the eyes when laughing, the person will be wicked.

passages.text: [the laughter] if it be of frequent occurrence, he will be happy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if a person laughs often, the person will be happy.

passages.text: [the laughter] and if it be repeated at the end, he will become mad.
passages.summary: The text says that if the laughter repeats at its end, the person will go mad.

passages.text: If there be three long lines in the forehead, the person will live for 100 years ;
passages.summary: The text says that three long lines on the forehead mean the person will live 100 years.

passages.text: [the forehead] if four lines, he will be a king and will live for 93 years.
passages.summary: The text says that four forehead lines mean the person will be a king and live 93 years.

passages.text: If the lines be broken, the person will cohabit with a woman under prohibition ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead lines are broken, the person will have relations with a forbidden woman.

passages.text: if there be no lines in the forehead, he will live for 90 years ;
passages.summary: The text says that with no forehead lines the person will live 90 years.

passages.text: and if the lines be near the hair of the head, he will live for 80 years.
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead lines are near the hairline, the person will live 80 years.

passages.text: If there be five lines in the forehead, his age will be 70 ;
passages.summary: The text says that five forehead lines mean a lifespan of 70 years.

passages.text: if the lines be of the same length, his age will be sixty ;
passages.summary: The text says that forehead lines of equal length mean a lifespan of sixty years.

passages.text: if there be many lines, the age will be 50 ;
passages.summary: The text says that many forehead lines mean a lifespan of 50 years.

passages.text: and if the lines be bent, it will be 40.
passages.summary: The text says that bent forehead lines mean a lifespan of 40 years.

passages.text: If the lines in the forehead be in contact with the brows, the age will be 30 ;
passages.summary: The text says that forehead lines touching the eyebrows mean a lifespan of 30 years.

passages.text: [the lines in the forehead] if they be bent on the left side, it will be 20 ;
passages.summary: The text says that forehead lines bent on the left side mean a lifespan of 20 years.

passages.text: [the lines in the forehead] if short, the person will meet with early death.
passages.summary: The text says that short forehead lines mean an early death.

passages.text: If the lines be imperfect, the age shall be ascertained by proportion.
passages.summary: The text says that if the forehead lines are incomplete, the lifespan is worked out proportionally.

passages.text: If the head be round, the person will possess many cows ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is round, the person will own many cows.

passages.text: [the head] if it be broad and round like an umbrella, he will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is broad and round like an umbrella, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the head] if flat, he will lose his parent when young ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is flat, the person will lose a parent while young.

passages.text: [the head] and if long, he will live long.
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is long, the person will live long.

passages.text: If the head be like a pot, the person will be fond of meditation ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is pot-shaped, the person will be fond of meditation.

passages.text: [the head] if it appear as if two heads were joined together, he will be poor and wicked ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head looks like two heads joined together, the person will be poor and wicked.

passages.text: [the head] if sunk, he will be a great man;
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is sunken, the person will be a great man.

passages.text: [the head] and if exceedingly sunk, he will meet with ruin.
passages.summary: The text says that if the head is extremely sunken, the person will meet with ruin.

passages.text: If the hair of the head grow singly, be glossy, black, curling, with no split ends, soft, and not too much in quantity, the person will live in great comfort or will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the head hair grows singly and is glossy, black, curly, without split ends, soft and not too thick, the person will live in great comfort or be a king.

passages.text: If the hairs grow several together and if they be not of the same length or be of brown color or thick, split at the ends, not glossy, short, curling too much and too much in quantity, the person will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the head hairs grow in clusters, are uneven, brown or thick, split, dull, short, overly curly and too abundant, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the limbs be of disagreeable appearance without flesh and covered over with muscles, the person will be unhappy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the limbs look unpleasant, lack flesh and are covered with muscles, the person will be unhappy.

passages.text: [If the limbs be of disagreeable appearance without flesh and covered over with muscles,] and if otherwise, happy.
passages.summary: The text says that otherwise the person will be happy.

passages.text: To be a king three places must be broad, three things must be deep or high, six places high, four small, seven red, five long and five soft, as follows : —
passages.summary: The text says that to be a king, three body parts must be broad, three deep or high, six raised, four small, seven red, five long and five soft, as listed next.

passages.text: The breast, the forehead and the face must be broad;
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the chest, forehead and face must be broad.

passages.text: the navel, the voice and strength must be deep or high.
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the navel, voice and strength must be deep or great.

passages.text: The breast, arm-pit, nails, nose, face and the nape of the neck must be high ;
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the chest, armpits, nails, nose, face and nape of the neck must be raised.

passages.text: the penis, the back, the neck and the shanks must be short.
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the penis, back, neck and shins must be short.

passages.text: The corners of the eyes, soles of feet, palm of the hand, the corners of the mouth, the lower lip, the upper lip and the tongue must be red.
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the corners of the eyes, soles, palms, corners of the mouth, both lips and the tongue must be red.

passages.text: Teeth, fingers, hair of the head, the skin and nails must be soft or smooth.
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the teeth, fingers, head hair, skin and nails must be soft or smooth.

passages.text: The mouth, the eyes, the arms, the nose and the part between the nipples must be long.
passages.summary: The text says that for kingship the mouth, eyes, arms, nose and the space between the nipples must be long.

passages.text: Complexion in man, animals and birds is detected by persons learned in the matter and indicate both good and evil, and is like a lamp placed within a crystal vessel throwing its light on the objects around.
passages.summary: The text says that complexion in people, animals and birds is read by experts, signals both good and bad, and is like a lamp inside a crystal vessel lighting what is around it.

passages.text: The complexion discernible in shining teeth, skin, nails and hairs of the body and of the head will be attended with good smell if it be caused by the element of earth. It will make the person happy, rich, prosperous and virtuous.
passages.summary: The text says that a complexion from the earth element shows in shining teeth, skin, nails and hair with a good smell, and makes the person happy, rich, prosperous and virtuous.

passages.text: The complexion which is glossy, white, clean green and agreeable to look at is caused by the element of water ; it will make all creatures possessing it happy and successful in all their attempts and will produce wealth, comfort, luxury and prosperity.
passages.summary: The text says that a glossy, white, clean, greenish and pleasant complexion comes from the water element and brings happiness, success, wealth, comfort, luxury and prosperity.

passages.text: The complexion which indicates fear and is unbearable and of the color of the lotus, gold or fire, and which also indicates strength, power, and valor, is caused by the element of fire.
passages.summary: The text says that a fearsome, intense complexion colored like the lotus, gold or fire, showing strength, power and valor, comes from the fire element.

passages.text: The complexion which is [?], not glossy, black and of bad odour is caused by the element of air. It will cause to the person death or imprisonment, disease, ruin and loss of wealth.
passages.summary: The text says that a dull, black, bad-smelling complexion comes from the air element and brings death or imprisonment, disease, ruin and loss of wealth.

passages.text: The complexion which is of the color of the crystal, noble, clear and indicating wealth and generosity, is caused by the element of ether (Akas). It will give a person all that he desires.
passages.summary: The text says that a crystal-colored, noble, clear complexion showing wealth and generosity comes from the ether element and gives the person all he desires.

passages.text: Thus has been described the complexion caused by the elements of earth, water, fire, air, and akas — five in number. Some writers treat of five more complexions caused by the Sun, Vishnu, Indra, Yama and the Moon, and they have described in detail the properties of each.
passages.summary: The text says it has now described the five complexions from earth, water, fire, air and ether, and notes that some writers add five more attributed to the Sun, Vishnu, Indra, Yama and the Moon.

passages.text: [?] physical man is composed of the five elementary principles — earth, water, fire, air and akas. The lords of these are respectively Mercury (earth), Venus and the Moon (water), Mars and the Sun (fire), Saturn (air), and Jupiter (akas). Human life is divided into a number of Dasa periods presided over by the several planets (vide Chapter VIII of Brihat Jataka). In the period of a particular planet will predominate the elementary principle belonging to him, and therefore the complexion due to such principle will become discernible in such Dasa period. Suppose the Dasa period to be that of Mars, his element is fire; the complexion caused by the elementary principle of fire is described in stanza 93. This complexion will become discernible in the Dasa period of Mars; and so for the other planets.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the body is made of five elements ruled by planets (Mercury earth, Venus and Moon water, Mars and Sun fire, Saturn air, Jupiter ether), and that the complexion of a planet's element shows during that planet's period of life (Dasa).

passages.text: Again, in stanza 21 of Ch. VIII of his Brihat Jataka Varaha Mihira states that the complexion will be accompanied by certain other qualities due to the five elementary principles and discernible by their respective organs of sense. The main property of earth is smell, a quality discernible by the nose ; that of water is taste, a quality discernible by the tongue ; that of fire or light is shape or appearance, discernible by the eye; that of the air is touch, discernible by the body ; and that of akas is sound, discernible by the ear. Now suppose the Dasa period to be that of Venus. His element is water; the quality belonging to water is taste, discernible by the tongue; therefore in the Dasa period of Venus, the person will eat juicy meals according to his desire. Again, suppose the Dasa period to be that of Jupiter, his elementary principle is Akas; its property is sound, discernible by the ear ; the person's speech will be sweet and agreeable to the ear. In the Dasa period of Mercury (earth, smell) the person's body will be with an agreeable odour ; in the period of Mars (fire, sight), he will be of agreeable appearance, and in that of Saturn (air, touch), he will be of soft body. From these the particular Dasa period of a person may be ascertained.
passages.summary: The translator's note says each element links to a sense, so in a Venus period the person eats juicy meals, in Jupiter's the speech is sweet, in Mercury's the body smells pleasant, in Mars's the appearance is pleasing and in Saturn's the body is soft, which reveals the current period.

passages.text: If the voice be like the sound of the elephant, the bull, the chariot, the drum, the lion or the clouds, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the voice sounds like an elephant, bull, chariot, drum, lion or thunder clouds, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the voice] but if it be hoarse and rough like the braying of the ass, the person will be poor and unhappy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the voice is hoarse and rough like a donkey's bray, the person will be poor and unhappy.

passages.text: Strength consists in seven things — in the serum of flesh, the marrow of bones, the skin, bones, semen, blood and flesh. We shall now describe the properties of each.
passages.summary: The text says strength lies in seven things: serum of flesh, bone marrow, skin, bones, semen, blood and flesh, and that each will be described.

passages.text: If the mouth, lips, gum of teeth, tongue, corners of eyes, the anus, the hands and feet be red, the person is strong in blood ; he will live in comfort and will be married, wealthy and with sons.
passages.summary: The text says that if the mouth, lips, gums, tongue, eye corners, anus, hands and feet are red, the person is strong in blood and will live in comfort, marry, be wealthy and have sons.

passages.text: If the skin be glossy, the person will be rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the skin is glossy, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the skin] if [?], he will be happy and prosperous ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the skin has a further quality (illegible in the scan), the person will be happy and prosperous.

passages.text: [the skin] and if thin, intelligent.
passages.summary: The text says that if the skin is thin, the person will be intelligent.

passages.text: Such a person will be strong in marrow. He will possess a fair body.
passages.summary: The text says such a person will be strong in marrow and have a fair body.

passages.text: Persons strong in the serum of flesh will be rich and will have sons.
passages.summary: The text says people strong in the serum of flesh will be rich and have sons.

passages.text: If the bones be large, the person will be strong in bones. He will be strong, learned and beautiful.
passages.summary: The text says that a person with large bones is strong in bone and will be strong, learned and beautiful.

passages.text: If the serum be thick and much in quantity, he will be happy, prosperous, learned and beautiful.
passages.summary: The text says that if the serum is thick and plentiful, the person will be happy, prosperous, learned and beautiful.

passages.text: A person of full growth will be learned, rich and beautiful. He will be strong in flesh.
passages.summary: The text says a fully grown, well-fleshed person will be learned, rich and beautiful, and is strong in flesh.

passages.text: If the joints be close and well fitted, the person will live in comfort and ease.
passages.summary: The text says that if the joints are close and well fitted, the person will live in comfort and ease.

passages.text: If the five parts — mouth, tongue, teeth, eyes and nails be glossy, the person will have sons and will be rich, happy and prosperous ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the mouth, tongue, teeth, eyes and nails are glossy, the person will have sons and be rich, happy and prosperous.

passages.text: [If the five parts — mouth, tongue, teeth, eyes and nails be glossy,] if they be otherwise, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if these five parts are not glossy, the person will be poor.

passages.text: If the color be very bright and glossy, the person will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the body's color is very bright and glossy, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [the color] if moderately so, he will be wealthy and will have sons ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the color is moderately bright and glossy, the person will be wealthy and have sons.

passages.text: if the color be disagreeable to the eye, he will be poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if the color is unpleasant to look at, the person will be poor.

passages.text: [the color] if of a single color, he will be happy ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the body is of a single color, the person will be happy.

passages.text: [the color] and if mixed, miserable.
passages.summary: The text says that if the body's color is mixed, the person will be miserable.

passages.text: The peculiar character of a person must be ascertained from his face ; if the face be like that of the cow, the ox, the tiger, the lion or the Brahmini kite, he will defeat his enemies, be successful in fight, and will become a king.
passages.summary: The text says a person's particular character is read from the face, and that a face like a cow, ox, tiger, lion or Brahminy kite means he will defeat enemies, win in battle and become a king.

passages.text: If the face be like that of the monkey, the buffalo, the hog or the goat, he will have sons, will be rich and will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is like a monkey, buffalo, hog or goat, the person will have sons, be rich and live in comfort.

passages.text: and if the face be like that of the ass or the camel, the person will be poor and unhappy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the face is like a donkey's or camel's, the person will be poor and unhappy.

passages.text: If the height of the person be 108, 96, or 84 of his own inches (breadth of finger), he is respectively a superior, an average and an inferior man.
passages.summary: The text says that a height of 108, 96 or 84 of one's own finger-breadths marks a superior, average or inferior man respectively.

passages.text: If the weight of the body be half a bhara or 80 lbs., the person will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if the body weighs half a bhara (80 lbs), the person will live in comfort.

passages.text: [the weight of the body] if less, he will be afflicted with grief;
passages.summary: The text says that if the body weighs less than that, the person will suffer grief.

passages.text: if the weight be a bhara (160 lbs), he will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the body weighs one bhara (160 lbs), the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the weight of the body] and if it be a bhara and a half (240 lbs), he will be an emperor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the body weighs one and a half bhara (240 lbs), the person will be an emperor.

passages.text: The measurement of both height and weight is to be taken at the age of 20 in the case of women and 25 in the case of men, or it may be done in the last quarter of life.
passages.summary: The text says height and weight should be measured at age 20 for women and 25 for men, or in the last quarter of life.

passages.text: Man is of the nature of the earth, water, fire, wind, akas (ether), the Devas, the Naras, or the animals and birds. We shall describe each.
passages.summary: The text says a man's nature may be of earth, water, fire, wind, ether, the gods, humans, or animals and birds, and that each will be described.

passages.text: A person of the nature of earth will be of the odour of good flowers, will indulge in sexual intercourse, and will be of good breeding and of firm mind.
passages.summary: The text says a person of earthy nature will smell of good flowers, enjoy sex, be well bred and have a firm mind.

passages.text: A person of the nature of water, will drink much water, will be fond of women and will eat juicy meals.
passages.summary: The text says a person of watery nature will drink much water, be fond of women and eat juicy meals.

passages.text: A person of the nature of fire will be hasty and thoughtless, wicked and cruel, angry, hungry and gluttonous.
passages.summary: The text says a person of fiery nature will be hasty, thoughtless, wicked, cruel, angry, hungry and gluttonous.

passages.text: A person of the nature of the wind will be fickle-minded, thin and of irascible temper.
passages.summary: The text says a person of airy nature will be fickle, thin and quick-tempered.

passages.text: A person of the nature of Akas will be able, open-mouthed, skilled in a knowledge of sound and with holes in his limbs.
passages.summary: The text says a person of the nature of ether will be capable, open-mouthed, skilled in the knowledge of sound, and have holes in his limbs.

passages.text: A person of the nature of the Devas will be liberal in gifts, slightly angry and attached to friends.
passages.summary: The text says a person of godlike nature will be generous, only slightly prone to anger and devoted to friends.

passages.text: A person of human nature will be fond of music and jewels and inclined to share what he has with others.
passages.summary: The text says a person of human nature will love music and jewels and be inclined to share with others.

passages.text: A person of the nature of a Rakshasa will be exceedingly angry, wicked and sinful.
passages.summary: The text says a person of demonic (Rakshasa) nature will be extremely angry, wicked and sinful.

passages.text: A person of the nature of a Pisacha (devil) will be hasty, thoughtless, dirty and talkative and of a large body.
passages.summary: The text says a person of the nature of a Pisacha (a kind of devil) will be hasty, thoughtless, dirty, talkative and large-bodied.

passages.text: A person of the nature of animals and birds will be timid, hungry and gluttonous.
passages.summary: The text says a person of the nature of animals and birds will be timid, hungry and gluttonous.

passages.text: Thus the learned have described the Satwa quality of a man and this quality is also known as Prakriti — nature.
passages.summary: The text says this is how the learned describe a man's essential quality (Satwa), also called Prakriti or nature.

passages.text: If the gait be like that of the tiger, the swan, the elephant in rut, the bull or the peacock, the person will be a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if the walk is like a tiger, swan, elephant in rut, bull or peacock, the person will be a king.

passages.text: If the gait be noiseless and slow, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the walk is quiet and slow, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [the gait] and if it be fast and skipping, he will be poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if the walk is fast and skipping, the person will be poor.

passages.text: Generally, a person who has opportunities of walking out when suffering from ennui, of drinking when thirsty, and of protection when in fear, is considered by those learned in the lore as exceedingly happy.
passages.summary: The text says experts consider a person exceedingly happy who can go out when bored, drink when thirsty and find protection when afraid.

passages.text: Thus have I described briefly the features and qualities of man on examining the views of Rishis. He who studies this will be liked universally and will be honoured by the king.
passages.summary: The text says the author has briefly described a man's features and qualities from the views of the sages, and that whoever studies this will be widely liked and honored by the king.

passages.text: He who wishes to rule over countries shall marry a woman the nails of whose toes are glossy, high, thin and red, whose ankles are large, beautiful and both alike, whose toes are close and the soles of whose feet are of the color of the lotus.
passages.summary: The text says a man who wishes to rule over countries should marry a woman whose toenails are glossy, raised, thin and red, whose ankles are large, beautiful and matching, whose toes are close together and whose soles are lotus-coloured.

passages.text: If the lines in the feet be of the shape of the fish, the elephant driver's hook, the lotus, barley-grain, the plough or the sword, or if the feet be dry and soft, if the shanks be round and without hair and visible muscles, and if the knees be fleshy and both alike, the woman will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman will be happy if the lines on her feet form a fish, an elephant driver's hook, a lotus, a barley grain, a plough or a sword, or if her feet are dry and soft, her shins round and free of hair and visible muscle, and her knees fleshy and matching.

passages.text: If the thighs be like the trunk of the elephant, without hair and firm, the genital organ be broad and triangular in shape, the part just above it be large and high and like the shell of the turtle, if the glans penis be hid from view, the woman will be wealthy and happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose thighs are like an elephant's trunk, hairless and firm, whose genital area is broad and triangular with a large raised mound above it like a turtle shell, and whose inner part is hidden from view, will be wealthy and happy.

passages.text: If the buttocks be large, broad and fleshy, the woman will wear a girdle;
passages.summary: The text says a woman with large, broad and fleshy buttocks will wear a girdle.

passages.text: if the navel be broad, deep and turning from left to right, she will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose navel is broad, deep and turns from left to right will be happy.

passages.text: If the abdomen be without hair, with three skin folds, and if the bosoms be round, firm, large and both alike, the breast above it be without hair and soft and the neck be like the conch-shell, the woman will be wealthy and happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman with a hairless abdomen showing three skin folds, round, firm, large and matching breasts, a soft hairless chest and a neck shaped like a conch shell will be wealthy and happy.

passages.text: If the lower lip be red like the China rose, fleshy, beautiful and red like the cherry fruit, if the teeth be even and like the buds of jasmine, the woman will enjoy the pleasures of married life and will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose lower lip is red, fleshy and beautiful and whose teeth are even and like jasmine buds will enjoy married life and be happy.

passages.text: If the voice be sweet, simple and not meek and like the sound of the cuckoo or the swan, if the nose be smooth and beautiful and the holes alike, and if the eyes be of the color of the leaves of the blue lotus, the woman will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman with a sweet, simple, unmeek voice like a cuckoo or swan, a smooth beautiful nose with matching nostrils, and eyes the colour of blue lotus petals will be happy.

passages.text: If the brows do not meet and be not very broad, if they do not hang, if they be bent like the young moon, if the forehead be like the half moon, without hair and even, the woman will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose eyebrows do not meet, are not very broad, do not droop and curve like a young moon, and whose forehead is shaped like a half moon, hairless and even, will be happy.

passages.text: If the two ears be not very long, be fleshy, soft and both alike, and if the hairs on the head be glossy, black, soft, bent and grow singly, and if the head be even, the woman will be happy.
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose ears are not too long, fleshy, soft and matching, whose hair is glossy, black, soft, curled and grows one hair per root, and whose head is even, will be happy.

passages.text: If the lines in the hands (a) and feet be of the shape of a pitcher, a seat, a horse, an elephant, a chariot, the bilva tree, an eight sided post, an arrow, a flower wreath, a pendant, a chamara, an elephant driver's hook, a barley grain, a mountain, flag-staff, an arch-way, a fish, a cross, a sacrificial altar, a fan, a conch-shell, an umbrella or a lotos flower, the woman will become a queen.
passages.notes: (a) In the case of a woman, the left hand and in the case of a man the right hand shall be examined.
passages.summary: The text says a woman will become a queen if the lines on her hands and feet form any of a long list of shapes, including a pitcher, seat, horse, elephant, chariot, bilva tree, arrow, flower wreath, mountain, flagstaff, fish, conch shell, umbrella or lotus.

passages.text: If the wrists be invisible, the hands be like the lotus flower and soft, and if the finger joints be long, the woman will become a queen;
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose wrists are not prominent, whose hands are soft and lotus-like and whose finger joints are long will become a queen.

passages.text: if the palm of the hand be neither deep, nor high, if it be covered with benefic lines, the woman will live long,
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose palm is neither hollow nor raised and is covered with favourable lines will live long.

passages.text: [if the palm of the hand be neither deep, nor high, if it be covered with benefic lines, the woman] leading a married life and will have sons;
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose palm is neither hollow nor raised and is covered with favourable lines will lead a married life and have sons.

passages.text: [if the palm of the hand be neither deep, nor high, if it be covered with benefic lines,] she will live in Comfort, be wealthy and in the enjoyment of sexual pleasures.
passages.summary: The text says such a woman will live in comfort, be wealthy and enjoy sexual pleasures.

passages.text: If there be found a line issuing from the wrist and reaching the middle finger, or if vertical lines be found in the palm of the hand, either the woman will become a queen or her husband will become a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if a line runs from the wrist to the middle finger, or if there are vertical lines on the palm, either the woman will become a queen or her husband will become a king.

passages.text: If there be found a line issuing from below the little finger and reaching a place between the forefinger and the middle finger, the woman will live long; if short, her age will be proportionately short.
passages.summary: The text says a line running from below the little finger to between the forefinger and middle finger means the woman will live long, and if the line is short her life will be correspondingly short.

passages.text: The big lines below the root of the thumb indicate sons, and the small lines daughters.
passages.summary: The text says large lines below the base of the thumb indicate sons and small lines indicate daughters.

passages.text: If the lines be perfect, the children will live long, and if broken or short they will die early.
passages.summary: The text says that if these lines are complete the children will live long, and if broken or short they will die early.
passages.withheldReason: predicts death of children and lifespan

passages.text: Thus have been described the good features of women; the bad features are the reverse of these. We shall however proceed to state briefly the more remarkable ones.
passages.summary: The text says the good features of women have now been described, that the bad features are their opposites, and that it will briefly state the most notable bad ones.

passages.text: If either the little toe or the one next to it do not touch the ground, or if the toe next to the big toe be longer than the big toe, the woman will become unchaste
passages.summary: The text says a woman whose little toe or fourth toe does not touch the ground, or whose second toe is longer than her big toe, will have sexual relations outside marriage.

passages.text: [If either the little toe or the one next to it do not touch the ground, or if the toe next to the big toe be longer than the big toe, the woman] and will commit deeds of wickedness.
